data.content_ref: inline:SRC_005 and SRC_001 inherit a common abstraction from SRC_002: all three concern whether the problem text logically entails $6 or requires an unstated axiom. SRC_005 and SRC_001 occupy the 'pedagogical artifact with hidden axiom' branch of this abstraction; SRC_002 occupies the 'logical underdetermination' branch. The shared abstraction is 'the text underdetermines the answer unless an axiom is supplied'. SRC_005 and SRC_001 inherit it by treating the axiom as deliberately concealed by the exercise design; SRC_002 treats it as a logical gap awaiting explicit constraint. This relation is refuted if the inheritance claim reduces to 'all three talk about the same problem', or if SRC_005/SRC_001 can be fully described without any notion of an unstated or hidden axiom — a summary of the endpoints is not a relation.
